```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(collapse)
library(compositions)
library(posterior)
```

```{r}
final_df <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df_complete.rds")

model_df <- final_df %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

df_urban <- model_df %>% filter(urban_rural %in% "Urban")

# pop_3_18 by summing actual census age counts for 3-18

norm_pop <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/outputs/final_df.rds") %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, pop_3_18) %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022))

# Join correct pop_3_18 onto urban data before ILR transformation
df_urban <- df_urban %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022)) %>%
  select(-any_of("pop_3_18")) %>%
  left_join(norm_pop, by = "SA_PUB2022")

cat("pop_3_18 summary:\n")
print(summary(df_urban$pop_3_18))
cat("Missing pop_3_18:", sum(is.na(df_urban$pop_3_18)), "\n")

cols <- c("pct_0_12","pct_13_21","pct_22_40","pct_41_70","pct_71plus",
          "pct_0car","pct_1car","pct_2plus","pct_none_primary",
          "pct_secondary","pct_tertiary","pct_still_in_edu")

matrix_urban     <- df_urban %>% select(all_of(cols)) %>% as.matrix()
variables_ilr    <- ilr(acomp(matrix_urban))
variables_ilr_df <- as.data.frame(variables_ilr)
names(variables_ilr_df) <- paste0("ilr_", cols[-length(cols)])

df_urban_model <- df_urban %>%
  select(-all_of(cols)) %>%
  bind_cols(variables_ilr_df)
```

```{r}
df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    category          = factor(category),
    county            = factor(COUNTY_ENGLISH),
    urban_area        = factor(SA_URBAN_AREA_NAME),
    z_target_pop_norm = as.numeric(scale(target_pop_norm)),

    # Normalise walking accessibility per 1,000 children aged 3-18
    # access_walk_per_1000 = school places per 1,000 children in the area
    access_walk_per_1000 = 1000 * (access_walk_30 / pop_3_18),
    log10_walk_30        = log10(access_walk_per_1000 + 1),

    perc_active_prop = perc_active / 100,
    perc_active_beta = (perc_active_prop * (nrow(.) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(.)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(access_walk_30),
    !is.na(perc_active_beta),
    !is.na(county),
    !is.na(urban_area),
    !is.na(log10_walk_30),
    pop_3_18 > 0,
    access_walk_per_1000 < 100000
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("Rows for modelling:", nrow(df_urban_model), "\n")
cat("access_walk_per_1000 range:", range(df_urban_model$access_walk_per_1000, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("log10_walk_30 range:", range(df_urban_model$log10_walk_30, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r}
ilr_vars <- names(df_urban_model) %>%
  keep(~ str_starts(.x, "ilr_"))

df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(ilr_vars),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "z_{.col}"
    )
  )

# Add spline for log10_walk_30 instead of a linear term
# A spline allows the relationship to be curved rather than a straight line
# k = 5 means 5 basis functions - flexible but not overfitted
spline_terms <- c("s(log10_walk_30, k = 5)")

predictors <- c(
  paste0("z_", ilr_vars),
  spline_terms
)

formula_beta <- as.formula(
  paste("perc_active_beta ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
)
print(formula_beta)
```

```{r}
# Added prior for spline smoothness sds controls how wiggly the spline can be
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "phi"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds")
)
```

```{r model}
# cores = 4 runs chains, paralell
model_urban_walk <- brm(
  formula       = formula_beta,
  data          = df_urban_model,
  family        = Beta(link = "logit"),
  prior         = priors,
  chains        = 4,
  iter          = 4000,
  warmup        = 1000,
  seed          = 123,
  cores         = 4,
  control       = list(
    adapt_delta   = 0.97,
    max_treedepth = 12
  )
)

saveRDS(model_urban_walk, "D:/Final-Project/DATA/model_urban_walk.rds")
```

```{r}
summary(model_urban_walk)
plot(model_urban_walk)
```

```{r}
# Convergence checks

draws_summary <- posterior::summarise_draws(model_urban_walk)

rhat_bad <- draws_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(rhat), rhat > 1.01)

ess_bad <- draws_summary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ess_bulk),
    !is.na(ess_tail),
    ess_bulk < 400 | ess_tail < 400
  )

nuts <- nuts_params(model_urban_walk)

n_divergent <- nuts %>%
  filter(Parameter == "divergent__") %>%
  summarise(n = sum(Value)) %>%
  pull(n)

n_treedepth <- nuts %>%
  filter(Parameter == "treedepth__") %>%
  summarise(n = sum(Value >= 12)) %>%
  pull(n)

convergence_report <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "Rhat <= 1.01",
    "Bulk and Tail ESS >= 400",
    "No divergent transitions",
    "No max treedepth hits"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(rhat_bad) == 0,
    nrow(ess_bad) == 0,
    n_divergent == 0,
    n_treedepth == 0
  ),
  problem = c(
    paste(rhat_bad$variable, collapse = ", "),
    paste(ess_bad$variable, collapse = ", "),
    as.character(n_divergent),
    as.character(n_treedepth)
  )
)

print(convergence_report)
```

```{r}
# Marginal plot using plot_predictions from marginaleffects
# This is better for splines because it handles the curve correctly
# The x axis is back-transformed to show real school places per 1,000 children

plot_predictions(
  model_urban_walk,
  condition = "log10_walk_30"
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
    labels = c("0", "10", "100", "1,000")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of walking accessibility on active travel",
    subtitle = "Other predictors fixed at their average standardised value",
    x = "School places reachable per 1,000 children (30 min walk)",
    y = "Predicted active travel (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
